title: Pure Exosister
summary: Exosister cards with generic staples. The Exosisters come in pairs that name each other, and every one of them becomes an Exosister Xyz Monster on the spot when a card leaves either GY. Martha summons Elis from the Deck on an empty field, and Pax and Vadis search or summon a named pair. The Burst Protocol cards lead: Exosister Betrayal adds two Exosisters and gives an extra Normal Summon of a named sister, and Karmael Sets an Exosister Spell/Trap and turns an opposing effect into a harmless one. Martha and Vadis lock you into Exosisters for the turn.
main: Exosister Martha
Summons itself on an empty field and pulls Elis from the Deck.
Exosister Elis
Summons itself next to an Exosister; becomes an Exosister Xyz when a card leaves a GY.
Exosister Stella
Summons another Exosister from the hand; becomes an Exosister Xyz when a card leaves a GY.
Exosister Irene
Swaps an Exosister in hand for a draw; becomes an Exosister Xyz when a card leaves a GY.
Exosister Sophia
Draws next to another Exosister; becomes an Exosister Xyz when a card leaves a GY.
Exosister Betrayal
2026 support. Adds two Exosisters, gives an extra Normal Summon of a named sister, and banishes what they send to the GY.
Exosister Pax
Searches any Exosister card and summons a sister whose pair is out.
Exosister Arment
Quick-Play: ranks an Exosister into a different Exosister Xyz.
Exosister Carpedivem
Shields your Exosisters and negates a card name when you make an Exosister Xyz.
Exosister Vadis
Summons a named Exosister pair from the Deck.
Exosister Returnia
Banishes a card and Xyz Summons an Exosister on the spot.
